subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — volume step-ups, blended rates, new model routes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sullivan <tom.sullivan@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion pricing follow-up

Thanks for taking the call today, Tom — great to hear more about Stellar Retail's plans for expanding Redwood across your customer support and merchandising workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Current footprint: 10 production routes, ~120M tokens/month (Q2 average per your usage file).
- Expansion ask: add 4 new model routes for recommender and store search, plus rollups for a higher-throughput summarization route.
- Renewal: current contract ends 2026-09-30; you mentioned wanting a 12–24 month renewal with volume step-ups tied to seasonal peaks.

Pricing & cost qualification (from today's discussion):
- Target blended unit economics: $X per 1M tokens — you mentioned a target around $20–$25 / 1M tokens for a blended rate across routes.
- Budget range: preliminary target annual spend $150k–$350k depending on adoption (you said procurement will aim for the lower side but product wants flexibility).

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) I attached Q2 usage export that Rafael requested — please confirm the numbers match your internal reports (attachment: Stellar_Retail_usage_report_Q2.csv).
2) I'll send a pricing sketch that includes: a) tiered step-ups (monthly volume breakpoints), b) blended rate examples that combine GPU-heavy routes and cheaper embedding/text routes, and c) an optional add-on for new model routes (different price band).
3) CCing Neha for deal ops — she can own the SOW/contract timeline and intake for procurement.

Next meeting: can we do a 30-min pricing review on Thursday 8/20 at 9:00am PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a draft SOW we can iterate on.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: Stellar_Retail_usage_report_Q2.csv

From: Tom Sullivan <tom.sullivan@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <procurement@stellarretail.com>, billing@stellarretail.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:01:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Usage file looks good on first pass — Q2 average lines up with our internal telemetry (I'll confirm formally by EOD).
- On blended target: product was aiming for ~$22 / 1M tokens blended. That would get us comfortable committing to the 12-mo renewal with staged ramp.
- Procurement target: Priya's team is comfortable reviewing a $180k–$250k annual commitment depending on step-up timing and SLA terms.

Two asks ahead of Thursday: 
1) Can you show 2 pricing scenarios — (A) conservative adoption with 6-month step-ups, (B) aggressive adoption with immediate volume credits? We want to see the per-1M math and total annual spend for each.
2) For the new model routes: are those priced as separate routes (higher unit) or folded into the blended rate? If separate, please include an example per-route rate for a high-cost model (e.g., Llama-3-70B-ish equivalent inference cost).

I'll confirm the calendar for Thu 8/20 9:00am PT once Priya confirms.

—Tom
Tom Sullivan
Head of AI Product | Stellar Retail
Tom.Sullivan@stellarretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sullivan <tom.sullivan@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion pricing follow-up

Thanks Tom — plan below includes the two scenarios and concrete $/1M token math so procurement and product have the same view. See SOW draft attached (SOW-draft-v2.pdf) and a short table below.

Scenario A — conservative (6-month step-ups)
- Year 1 committed volumes: Months 1–3: baseline 120M/mo; Months 4–6: 160M/mo; Months 7–12: 220M/mo (seasonal ramps).
- Example blended rate: $28 / 1M tokens for Months 1–3, $24 / 1M for Months 4–6, $20 / 1M for Months 7–12 (weighted blended annual = ~$23.50 / 1M).
- Estimated annual spend (approx): $23.50 * (annual total tokens / 1M) => with projected total 1.86B tokens => ~$43.7k? (note: check arithmetic) — will compute precise total in attached pricing sheet.

Scenario B — aggressive (immediate credits / step-ups)
- Year 1 committed volumes: immediate 200M/mo steady, ramp to 300M/mo by month 6.
- Example blended rate: $22 / 1M across committed volume, with CPU/GPU route differentials folded via credits for expensive routes.
- Estimated annual spend: ~ $22 * projected tokens => roughly $52.8k (formal calc in sheet).

New model routes/options
- Option 1 (folded): include new routes in blended rate but apply model-tier multipliers for heavy models (+1.5–2x on per-route rate) for LLMs that require higher GPU compute.
- Option 2 (separate): bill expensive routes at a higher per-1M rate (example: $45–$60 / 1M for a 70B-class route) and leave standard text/embedding routes in the blended bucket ($18–$25 / 1M).

Next steps I will deliver before our Thu meeting: 
- Cleaned pricing workbook with line-by-line math and final blended annual numbers (Rafael is pulling exact Q2->Q3 projection numbers).
- Draft SOW for 12-mo term with step-up schedule (attached: SOW-draft-v2.pdf).
- A short note on SLA/credits for unplanned downtime for Dedicated capacity.

Neha / Rafael — can you double-check the blended math and confirm the final annual totals so I can include them in the SOW? Rafael, I left placeholders in the sheet for the per-route multipliers.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion pricing follow-up (internal)

Quick internal note — validated Q2 numbers against our ingestion logs and updated the pricing workbook:
- Corrected annual token projection to 1.86B (based on seasonality and the proposed step-ups).
- Scenario A weighted blended = $24.10 / 1M tokens (annualized).
- Scenario B weighted blended = $21.95 / 1M tokens (annualized) if new expensive routes are capped to <=15% of total tokens; if >15% then blended goes to ~$26 / 1M.

I updated SOW placeholders (see SOW-draft-v2.pdf) and added a short clause for model-tier multipliers and an example table of route tiers. I'll attach the updated pricing workbook to the calendar invite.

Recommended reply to Tom/Priya for Thu: include both scenarios and highlight the blended $/1M numbers up-front (Scenario A: $24.10 / 1M; Scenario B: $21.95 / 1M conditional). Also call out the per-route example for a high-cost model: $50 / 1M as a reference for a 70B-class route.

Rafael
Lead Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
